component.name: sshTIK
component.summary: SSH terminal with pop-up SFTP and MySQL helpers

description.p: sshTIK is a plain SSH terminal until you need more. Press F5 and a dual-pane file transfer window opens, already sitting in the directory your remote shell is in. Press F6 while you are at a mysql prompt and a database browser opens on the same connection, with an editable data grid, table structure and query history.
Everything runs over the single SSH connection you already authenticated: no second login, no separate FTP server, no tunnels to configure.

ul.li: Tabbed VTE terminal with saved hosts and ~/.ssh/config integration
SFTP file manager with drag-and-drop, recursive transfers and edit-remote-file-locally
MySQL/MariaDB browser that picks up the client you already launched

screenshot.caption: A plain SSH terminal until you press a function key
F5: file transfer, remote pane already in the shell's directory
F6: database browser with an editable grid, on the same connection

description.p: Dual-pane MySQL commander, and a Midnight-Commander-style file panel.

ul.li: F6 is now a two-pane MySQL browser: local server on the left, the SSH host's server on the right, with copy/move of tables and whole databases between them (mysqldump | mysql)
Databases and tables shown with size bars; F5 Copy, F6 Move, F7 Create database, F8 Drop, F3 view rows; per-pane connect with optional remembered logins
File panel: function-key bar (F2 Rename, F3 View, F4 Edit, F5 Copy, F6 Move, F7 New Folder, F8 Delete), Tab to switch panes, wildcard +/- select, '/' to jump to the path
Finds the ssh-agent that holds keys when launched from a desktop menu, so key auth works without a terminal
Table-size overview when a database is selected; saved hosts sorted alphabetically
MySQL password prompt for restricted users (mysql -u name -p)
Login banner is preserved on connect; no screen-clear
Esc closes the file and database panels
Fixed the connection dropping when saving an edited remote file
Clearer transfer errors; one failed file no longer aborts the batch
Terminal inset, zebra rows and column lines, database cell padding
F4 opens Connect; About dialog and version readout with build info
Flatpak packaging (builds GTK 3 VTE into the app); Flathub submission manifest
Column headers with underscores display correctly; primary-key marker no longer needs an emoji font
Follow nested ssh: F5/F6 open on the host you ssh'd onward to, tunnelled through the current session
Fix installation via pipx (use the distro's GTK/VTE/paramiko); add install.sh with menu entry and icon
